shared_elements: small schematic human-like figures with limbs
repeated parallel short strokes forming a comb-like row
incised or carved marks on natural stone
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic profile animals, small stick-like anthropomorphs and a band of closely repeated short parallel strokes, which is the most specific correspondence between them. But A is a vertical, deeply modelled relief with figures stacked in tiers on a shaped monolith, while B is a flat outcrop covered with shallow, flat, silhouette-and-outline pecked marks scattered without register order, so the manner of execution and the compositional logic are quite different.
